hero.headline: Cash gifts that unlock on a surprise date
hero.subheadline: Send money that stays completely hidden until the perfect moment. Birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day — make every gift unforgettable.

escrow.title: Time-Locked Escrow
escrow.desc: Funds are held in a Soroban smart contract — no one can touch them until the unlock date.

stable.title: Stable Value
stable.desc: Gifts are denominated in USDC so the amount never changes between sending and claiming.

fees.title: Near-Zero Fees
fees.desc: Stellar's high-speed network means more of your money reaches the recipient.

ramp.title: NGN On/Off-Ramp
ramp.desc: Pay in Naira via Paystack. Recipients can withdraw directly to their Nigerian bank account.

create.title: Create a gift
create.desc: Enter the recipient's phone number, the amount in Naira, and choose a surprise unlock date.

pay.title: Pay securely
pay.desc: Complete payment via Paystack or card. Funds are converted to USDC and locked on-chain.

notify.title: Recipient gets notified
notify.desc: They receive an SMS telling them a gift is waiting — but the amount stays hidden.

unlock.title: Gift unlocks on the day
unlock.desc: At the exact date and time you chose, the gift is revealed and the recipient can claim it.
